status_at_commit: Plan and all data frozen before training or generation on the 24 reserved cases
hypothesis: Balanced examples preserving owners and participant roles may reduce the writing candidate's ownership errors, with separately reported transfer to reserved constructions.

training.optimizer: fresh AdamW; continue adapter weights, not optimizer state

evaluation.review: Compare complete outputs with case requirements; report ownership, negation, action and extra invented information. Exact reference matches are only a diagnostic, not semantic accuracy.
evaluation.additional_checks: Existing 50 writing-development prompts and original general smoke cases for regression inspection; no old reserved holdout.

selection_policy: One fixed training run. No hyperparameter or example changes in response to reserved outputs. Review all outputs and report per construction. Any later tuned run needs newly reserved patterns/data to support a fresh generalization claim.
promotion_policy: No automatic stable or browser promotion. Any published adapter must remain experimental and include its failures and evaluation scope.
